tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page behind everything: the grouped background cards sit on.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped lists and sheets resting on ground.

tokens.name: card-raised
tokens.usage: A card on a card: fields inside a sheet, a selected row.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Quiet controls: chips at rest, segmented tracks, the date and time pills, keypad keys in dark.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: The selected segment's thumb and pressed states on fill.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row separators inside a card. Cards themselves carry no border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ground and card. Also the fill of the primary pill button.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill: the primary pill's label.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: a row's meta line, a section title, field labels. 4.5:1 on ground and card.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels and chevrons. Never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: win
tokens.usage: A positive result or balance, as text or a figure. 4.5:1 on ground, card and fill in both themes.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: A negative result, the destructive pill and errors. Shown with a minus sign, never by color alone.

tokens.name: win-tint
tokens.usage: The ground of a winning result chip.

tokens.name: loss-tint
tokens.usage: The ground of a losing result chip, and the destructive confirm row.

tokens.name: felt
tokens.usage: Live play. A live session fills the screen with felt; the live dot and LiveBar timer use it too.

tokens.name: felt-deep
tokens.usage: The lower band of the live screen and the sheet scrim over felt.

tokens.name: felt-ink
tokens.usage: The live amount, the clock and labels on felt. 5:1 on felt.

tokens.name: felt-soft
tokens.usage: The game line and secondary text on felt; large sizes only.

tokens.name: live-text
tokens.usage: The word "live" and a running time on card or ground. 4.5:1 in both themes; felt itself is for fills.

tokens.name: chip-red
tokens.usage: The $5 chip. Craps, and the first player color.

tokens.name: chip-blue
tokens.usage: The $10 chip. Poker, cash and tournament.

tokens.name: chip-green
tokens.usage: The $25 chip. Roulette. Never a result: a result is win or loss.

tokens.name: chip-black
tokens.usage: The $100 chip. Blackjack. Turns light in dark so its bar still shows.

tokens.name: chip-purple
tokens.usage: The $500 chip. Baccarat.

tokens.name: chip-orange
tokens.usage: The $1,000 chip. Slots.

tokens.name: chip-grey
tokens.usage: Other games and a game not set yet.

tokens.name: tint-purple
tokens.usage: Ground of a soft secondary pill, paired with chip-purple ink.

tokens.name: tint-blue
tokens.usage: Ground of a soft secondary pill, paired with chip-blue ink.

tokens.name: tint-orange
tokens.usage: Ground of a soft secondary pill, paired with chip-orange ink.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar, LiveBar and menus, over a backdrop blur.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px, offset 2px.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Inter Tight", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
families.rounded: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", Nunito, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: live-amount
styles.usage: The live screen's big number on felt: what you've bought in for. Tabular figures. The clock stays small, in the LIVE pill.

styles.name: money-hero
styles.usage: The one figure a screen is about: the month's result, a final result.

styles.name: money-row
styles.usage: The amount at the end of a session or player row.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: A pushed page's large title, left-aligned, on ground. Pushed pages only: tab roots have no large title.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A card's heading, a profile name, a sheet with a big subject.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, sheet titles, navigation titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tap + to start your first session.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Feed lines, notes under a field, menu items.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: A row's meta line, times, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase stat labels over a figure: RESULT, HOURS, SESSIONS, BUY-IN.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a stat label and its figure.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; between pill buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding top and bottom; gap inside a card's header.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections on ground.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a large title; around the live amount.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, date and time pills, keypad keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small cards inside a sheet, avatar squares.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped lists on ground.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets' top corners and the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, chip, segmented control and the LiveBar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on ground. Barely there: the fill difference does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The tab bar, LiveBar and menus.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet rising over the screen.
